name: highlight-open-files
description: Highlight currently open files in the editor tabs and explorer with a configurable color and badge.

highlightOpenFiles.decorations.enable.co.markdownDescription:
Enable colored labels on the tabs and explorer entries of all currently open files.

Requires `#workbench.editor.decorations.colors#` and `#explorer.decorations.colors#` to be enabled.

The highlight color can be customized via `workbench.colorCustomizations`: `highlightOpenFiles.openFiles`.

highlightOpenFiles.decorations.enable.ba.markdownDescription:
Enable badge characters on the tabs and explorer entries of all currently open files.

Requires `#workbench.editor.decorations.badges#` and `#explorer.decorations.badges#` to be enabled.

The badge character can be configured via `#highlightOpenFiles.decorations.badge#`.

highlightOpenFiles.decorations.badge.markdownDescription:
The badge character shown on tabs and explorer entries of open files. Accepts 1-2 characters, including unicode (e.g. `⬤`, `★`, `🔥`).

Only visible when `#highlightOpenFiles.decorations.enable.badges#` is enabled.

colors.description: Color for open file editor labels and explorer entries
